name: Market
_note: Phase G2: the Market (Bramble the trader), buildable at Hearthtree level 2; Thistle the hare comes free with it. H5 (27 Nov 2026): one level, no Upgrade. The pet is bought and trained on its Pets tab, the mount's level comes from the Saddlery (Data.mount_level). A Market an old save had upgraded keeps the health it earned (Save.market_hp_floor, the owner's Q5 A; Data.building_hp).
